english: Haaah… fuuuh…
What is the matter?
Up until now, Mama said I could do whatever I wanted, right?\nAnd then she goes and…
Do you dislike the extermination order?
Mie likes fun stuff.\nExtermination is no fun at all.
I, too, prefer data analysis\nand building optimized energy systems\nover combat.
Sheesh…\nI really don't wanna do 'that'.
I see.\nThen I will sortie first.\nMie, please remain on standby.
Really?
Combat is neither liked nor disliked.\nWhat Mie dislikes,\nI shall do instead.
Okay… then I'll leave it to you.
Then I will begin the extermination mission.
Maintenance after so long.\nGood work, Shenlong!
If they saw our IS combat data,\nthey'd be shocked.
No doubt.\n…My sister's probably gleefully\nanalyzing it right about now.
The political situation in Europe seems to have calmed down a bit as well.
Well, they're probably kicking each other under the table\nwhere no one can see.
While we're at it, should we look for [CLAUDE] too?
That sounds good!
Ah, but IS Academy only has female students, right?\nIt's hard to imagine [CLAUDE]\nbeing here…
He could be outside the academy, though…
Waaah!?
Report from the observation room!\nIntruder in the IS Academy arena!
The only ones who could pull that off\nare those guys!
Move out! Hurry!
IS Academy…
Key! You came back just to lose again!?
Barging into IS Academy -\nwhat do you think you're doing?!
I was created based on IS.
So what?
Your future is me.\nYou, who are the past, are unnecessary.
Fufu, how amusing.\nAnd who was it that lost to that so-called past?
I have no memory of losing.\nA database anomaly merely\ninterrupted combat.
Don't act tough! We won't fall behind you anymore!
…Do you know why\nI was gathering data?
What…?
It was not to win.
Then what the hell for!?
Is IS a tool for killing each other?
It is not!\nIS was originally meant for space development…
Don't tell me your goal\nis IS's original purpose…?
I still do not understand.\nWhy do humans try to use superior technology and energy\nfor destruction?
That is…
IS, Symphogear, the Angels' Tears, Void magic,\nthe power of dreams… Why use them to fight?
You have no right to say that!\nYou, who killed Eve!!
Mie and I are merely executors.\nWe only follow our master's decision.
Not just Eve. Our master has decided\non the extermination of humanity and the erasure of this world.
You're spouting that crazy talk again?
I think: if humanity could use the technology and power\nit has gained to better ends,\nperhaps our master's decision could change.
Are you saying it's humanity's fault\nthey're being destroyed?\nIf so, that's sophistry!
What?
And what did YOU do?\nDid you ever show anyone the right way to use power?\nNo, you didn't.
The 'demon' who started indiscriminate battles across Europe\nand sowed the seeds of conflict -\nwho was that, I wonder!
I needed data.
Someone who kills people so easily for a reason like that\nhas no right to judge humanity!
Exactly!\nFine words without actions to back them up\nmake you nothing but a liar!
Preach all you want -\nyou have no right to destroy humanity!
Let me throw your favorite line back at you!\n'Incomprehensible!' That's you!
Dialogue is meaningless.\nExtermination is decided. Beginning execution.
I won't let you! Never!
Damage rate confirmed past the limit.\nContinued combat impossible.
She went down fast…
Not yet, Houki!\nKey hasn't fully shut down!
Enough - finish her!!
Huh!?
What is this light…?
Energy readings spiking!\nWhat's happening!?
Activating new function.
No way!? A One-Off Ability!?
What did you say!?
Ending combat mode.\nShifting to extermination mode.
Key's energy levels are way too dangerous!!
Doesn't mean we're backing down!
Looks like the real fight starts now!
Let's do this!!
The five of us in sync - and our sync with everyone else -\nwe'll use it to the max!
I know!
We pour out everything we've gained and win - nothing else!
Hm! She's… focused entirely on fighting!
Kill!
I won't lose! Let's go, Akatsubaki!!
My word!\nDrop your guard for an instant and she'll finish you!
Destroy!
No time for pride!\nTaking her down!!
Bring it on!\nWe're going all-out for real this time!
Break!
Shenlong! No holding back!\nFull power, full throttle! Charge ahead!\nSoooooooryaaaaa!!
An attack-specialized build with no thought for defense -\nscary stuff!
Fight!
But her moves are easy to read -\nhas she noticed?\nAttacks like that don't land easily!
She fights like I used to.\nSelf-absorbed, and therefore without hesitation.
Rage!
I can't lose - no, I won't lose!\nNot to you, who misunderstands what strength means!
We can do this! We're dealing real damage!
Keep up the pressure!
…F… fufu…! Fufufu!
Huh!?
Key laughed…?
I see… So this is what 'fun' is!
'Fun'…?
Different from Mie's fun… Going all out,\nthat is my… fufufu!\nFun! Comprehensible!
She's talking like some battle junkie!
She denounced humanity for fighting, yet\nfeels joy in battle -\nhow ironic…!
Fight! More! Fight!\nHahahahahahahahahahahah!\nHahahahahahahahahahahah!
So she's awakened to the joy of wielding power…\nBut that is nothing but the outburst\nof an immature spirit!
…Extermination mode, forcibly terminated…!
Why… can't I win…?\nMaster… why…!
Couldn't finish her off…!
Tough one, as expected.
But a win is a win.
IS Academy's safe too - hooray all around!
That's right! Let's celebrate!
Yeah.
Take that, nyo! Go eat dirt, nyo!
Don't say it after she's gone, nyu.
Wheee, we've gotten stronger, desu~.
Hweee, we've gotten stronger~.
You're one to talk!
Welcome back, Kee-chan.
I was defeated… Cannot identify the cause.
You couldn't win even in extermination mode?
Correct. As you can see.
I see.
Fine, Mie's going out.
It's Mama's order, after all.\nHaaah… I don't wanna…
